NULLBORNE CULTIST
CR 6

XP 2,400
LE Medium humanoid (human)
Init +2, Senses Perception +9

DEFENSE

AC 20, touch 12, flat-footed 18 (+2 Dex, +6 armor, +2 shield)
hp 75 (10d8 +30)
Fort +10, Ref +4, Will +4

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee light flail +11/+6 (1d6+4 bludgeoning)

STATISTICS

Str 18, Dex 14, Con 16, Int 9, Wis 8, Cha 11
Base Atk +7; CMB +11, CMD 23

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Magic Hunter (Ex)

Characters that have spellcasting abilities (be it by race, class, or any other reason) suffer double damage from the null born cultist.
